itens.titulo: Chegou o Kali Linux 2026.3 e traz novas ferramentas de hacking ético
itens.resumo: A equipa responsável pelo Kali Linux anunciou a versão 2026.3 da conhecida distribuição Linux dedicada à cibersegurança, aos testes de intrusão e ao hacking ético. A nova versão traz um conjunto de ferramentas de segurança, melhorias no ambiente gráfico, um kernel atualizado e novidades para o Kali NetHunter, incluindo funcionalidades para smartwatches. itens.titulo: CVE-2026-112346: OpenHands Software Agent SDK before 1.52.0 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability where the DockerWorkspace and…
itens.resumo: OpenHands Software Agent SDK before 1.52.0 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability where the DockerWorkspace and Apptainer workspace launchers bind the sandbox agent server to all network interfaces (0.0.0.0) with an empty session_api_keys list, disabling authentication by default. Attackers who can reach the published container port can send unauthenticated HTTP and WebSocket requests to execute arbitrary shell commands as root in the sandbox, access the mounted workspace, and read plaintext secrets from the secrets store.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-116508: A security flaw has been discovered in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104
itens.resumo: A security flaw has been discovered in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected by this issue is the function sub_402340 of the file infostat.cgi of the component Device-Information CGI. Performing a manipulation of the argument CONTENT_LENGTH results in stack-based buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-116485: danmu_api before 1.21.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify server environment…
itens.resumo: danmu_api before 1.21.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify server environment configuration when the default TOKEN is used and ADMIN_TOKEN is unset. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/env/set, /api/env/add, or /api/env/del to set ADMIN_TOKEN, lock out operators, redirect OTHER_SERVER or PROXY_URL for SSRF, and trigger redeployment.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-116231: A security flaw has been discovered in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1
itens.resumo: A security flaw has been discovered in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1. The impacted element is an unknown function of the component Ser2net. Performing a manipulation of the argument regmsg results in crlf injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
